ei.title: 2번: The Healing Power of Medical Clowns
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Although being ill is quite serious, some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and reduce the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as effective as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite (A)[serious / trivial], some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and (B)[increase / reduce] the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as (C)[effective / useless] as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) serious=심각한 / trivial=사소한 (B) reduce=줄이다 / increase=늘리다 (C) effective=효과적인 / useless=쓸모없는
det.analysis:
① serious — reduce — effective: 아픈 것은 '심각'하고, 광대는 스트레스를 '줄이'며, 웃음은 약만큼 '효과적' ←정답

② trivial: 아픈 것은 사소한(trivial) 게 아니라 심각함 — 부적절

③ increase/useless: 스트레스를 '늘리'거나 웃음이 '쓸모없다'는 문맥과 반대

④ trivial/increase: (A)(B) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 아픔=심각(serious), 광대=스트레스 감소(reduce), 웃음=효과적(effective)

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite serious, some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and reduce the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as effective as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to (A)[entertain / annoy] children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same (B)[increase / reduction] in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is (C)[doubted / believed] that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) entertain=즐겁게 하다 / annoy=짜증나게 하다 (B) reduction=감소 / increase=증가 (C) believed=여겨지는 / doubted=의심받는
det.analysis:
① increase: 광대와 만난 아이들은 불안의 '감소(reduction)'를 보임 — increase는 반대

② entertain — reduction — believed: 아이들을 '즐겁게' 하고, 불안이 '감소'하며, 자폐 아동에게도 쓰일 수 있다고 '여겨진다' ←정답

③ annoy/doubted: '짜증나게'와 '의심받는'은 문맥과 반대

④ doubted: 마지막이 '의심받는'은 부적절
det.tip: 광대=즐겁게(entertain), 결과=불안 감소(reduction), 활용=여겨진다(believed)

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite serious, some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients (A)[panic / relax] and reduce the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as effective as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being (B)[prepared / recovered] for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the (C)[same / different] reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) relax=편안해지다 / panic=공황에 빠지다 (B) prepared=준비되는 / recovered=회복된 (C) same=같은 / different=다른
det.analysis:
① panic: 광대는 환자를 '편안하게(relax)' 하려 함 — panic은 반대

② recovered/different: 아이들은 수술을 '준비 중'이고, 결과는 진정제 그룹과 '같음' — recovered/different는 부적절

③ relax — prepared — same: '편안하게' + 수술 '준비 중' + '같은' 정도의 불안 감소 ←정답

④ different: 두 그룹 결과가 '같음'이므로 different는 반대
det.tip: 광대=편안(relax), 수술 준비(prepared), 같은(same) 감소

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite ①<u>serious</u>, some trips to the hospital now ②<u>include</u> unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and ③<u>reduce</u> the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as ④<u>useless</u> as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① serious(심각한): 아픈 것은 심각하다 — 적절

② include(포함하다): 병원 방문이 이제 웃음을 포함한다 — 적절

③ reduce(줄이다): 광대는 스트레스를 줄이도록 돕는다 — 적절

④ useless(쓸모없는): 웃음은 '일부 약물만큼 효과적(effective)'이라고 했으므로 '쓸모없는(useless)'은 반대예요. effective로 고쳐야 해요 ←정답
det.tip: as ___ as some medication = 약물만큼 → effective(효과적). useless는 반대

The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① trips(방문): 병원으로의 일부 방문 — 적절

② include(포함하다): 이제 웃음을 포함한다 — 적절

③ panic(공황에 빠지다): 광대의 목적은 환자를 '편안하게(relax)' 하는 것이라 '공황에 빠지게(panic)'는 반대예요. relax로 고쳐야 해요 ←정답

④ effective(효과적인): 웃음이 약만큼 효과적 — 적절
det.tip: help patients ___ = 환자를 편안하게(relax). panic(공황)은 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① serious(심각한): 아픈 것은 심각하다 — 적절

② effective(효과적인): 웃음이 약만큼 효과적 — 적절

③ surgery(수술): 수술을 앞둔 아이들 — 적절

④ increase(증가): 광대를 만난 아이들은 진정제 그룹과 '같은 정도의 불안 감소(reduction)'를 보였으므로 '증가(increase)'는 반대예요. reduction으로 고쳐야 해요 ←정답
det.tip: 실험 결과 = 불안 감소(reduction). increase(증가)는 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for ___(___을 준비하고 있는 아이들을 즐겁게 하려고 광대를 보냈다)'예요. 병원에서 아이들이 준비하는 것은 수술이죠.

① medicine: '약을 준비한다'는 부자연스러움

② surgery: 병원에서 아이들이 준비하는 것 = 수술 ←정답

③ school: 학교는 병원 맥락과 무관

④ lunch: 점심은 실험 맥락과 무관
det.tip: being prepared for ___ = 수술(surgery)을 준비 중

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'showed the same reduction in ___(같은 정도의 ___ 감소를 보였다)'예요. 광대와 진정제 실험은 '불안'을 다루죠.

① anxiety: 불안의 감소 — 광대·진정제로 다루는 대상 ←정답

② laughter: '웃음의 감소'는 광대가 웃음을 주는 것과 모순

③ surgery: '수술의 감소'는 문맥과 무관

④ money: '돈의 감소'는 지문과 무관
det.tip: reduction in ___ = 불안(anxiety)의 감소

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'the laughter ... is as effective as some ___(웃음은 일부 ___만큼 효과적이다)'예요. 뒤 실험에서 웃음을 진정제(약)와 비교하죠.

① exercise: 운동과 비교하지 않음

② laughter: 웃음을 웃음과 비교하는 건 어색

③ medication: 웃음을 '약물'과 비교 — 뒤의 진정제 실험과 일치 ←정답

④ silence: 침묵과 비교하지 않음

det.analysis:

④ decrease: 감소시키다 — reduce의 동의어 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 entertain과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: entertain=즐겁게 하다 / amuse=즐겁게 하다 / ignore=무시하다 / examine=진찰하다 / frighten=겁주다
det.analysis:
① amuse: 즐겁게 하다 — entertain의 동의어 ←정답

② ignore: 무시하다 — 의미 다름

③ examine: 진찰하다 — 의미 다름

④ frighten: 겁주다 — entertain과 반대
det.tip: entertain(즐겁게 하다) = amuse

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 serious와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: serious=심각한 / funny=웃긴 / grave=심각한, 중대한 / minor=사소한 / calm=차분한
det.analysis:
① funny: 웃긴 — serious와 반대

② grave: 심각한, 중대한 — serious의 동의어 ←정답

③ minor: 사소한 — serious와 반대

④ calm: 차분한 — 의미 다름
det.tip: serious(심각한) = grave(중대한/심각한)

det.korean: painful=고통스러운 / harmful=해로운 / serious=심각한 / sudden=갑작스러운 / pleasant=기분 좋은
det.analysis:
① harmful: 해로운 — 부정적 뜻이라 painful과 비슷한 축

② serious: 심각한 — 의미 다름

③ sudden: 갑작스러운 — 의미 다름

④ pleasant: 기분 좋은 — painful(고통스러운)의 반의어 ←정답
det.tip: painful(고통스러운)의 반대 = pleasant(기분 좋은)

Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as <u>effective</u> as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 effective와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
① useful: 유용한 — effective와 비슷

② strong: 강한 — effective와 비슷한 축

③ useless: 쓸모없는 — effective(효과적인)의 반의어 ←정답

④ powerful: 강력한 — effective와 비슷
det.tip: effective(효과적인)의 반대 = useless(쓸모없는)

questions.passage:
(A) One group of kids <u>spent</u> about half an hour with a clown at the hospital before their treatment. The children looked much happier afterward.

(B) He <u>spent</u> all of his allowance on comic books and had no money left for the weekend. His mother was quite upset about it.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 spent의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① (A) 시간을 보내다 (B) 돈을 쓰다: (A)는 광대와 '30분을 보냈다', (B)는 용돈을 '다 썼다' ←정답

② (A) 돈을 쓰다 (B) 시간을 보내다: (A)(B)가 서로 뒤바뀜

③ (B) 지치게 하다: (B)는 돈을 쓴 것이지 지치게 한 게 아님

④ (A) 다 써 버리다: (A)는 시간을 보낸 것이라 부적절
det.tip: spend + 시간 = (시간을) 보내다 / spend + 돈 = (돈을) 쓰다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a drug that makes a person calm or sleepy"

det.analysis:
정의 'a drug that makes a person calm or sleepy(사람을 차분하거나 졸리게 만드는 약)'는 진정제를 뜻해요.

① vaccine: 백신 — 질병 예방용이라 다름

② sedative: 진정제 — 마음을 진정시키는 약 ←정답

③ bandage: 붕대 — 약이 아님

④ syringe: 주사기 — 도구이지 약이 아님
det.tip: calm or sleepy하게 만드는 약 = sedative(진정제)

questions.passage: It is __________ (believe) that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: believe(동사: 믿다) → believed (과거분사). 수동태 be believed 구문
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'It is __________ (believe) that ...(~라고 여겨진다)'예요. 'It is + 과거분사 + that'은 '~라고 여겨진다/믿어진다'라는 수동태 구문이라, believe를 과거분사 believed로 바꿔야 해요.

believe(믿다) → believed(be + p.p. 수동태)
det.tip: It is _____ that ~ = ~라고 여겨진다 → believed (수동태 be + p.p.)

questions.passage: The kids who met with clowns showed the same __________ (reduce) in anxiety as those who were given the sedative.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: reduce(동사: 줄이다) → reduction (명사: 감소). 관사 the 뒤 명사 자리
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'the same __________ (reduce) in anxiety(같은 정도의 불안 ___)'예요. 'the same' 뒤 명사 자리이므로 동사 reduce를 명사 reduction으로 바꿔야 해요.

reduce(줄이다, 동사) → reduction(감소, 명사)
det.tip: the same ___ in anxiety → 명사 자리 → reduction(감소)

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite serious, some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and reduce the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as effective as some medication. In one experiment, __________ sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with autism and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'In one experiment, ___ sent clowns to entertain children(한 실험에서 ___가 아이들을 즐겁게 하려고 광대를 보냈다)'예요. 실험을 진행하며 광대를 보내는 주체는 연구자죠.

① patients: 환자는 실험 대상이지 광대를 보내는 주체가 아님

② parents: 부모는 실험을 진행하지 않음

③ researchers: 실험에서 광대를 보낸 주체 = 연구자 ←정답

④ clowns: 광대는 보내진 대상이지 보내는 주체가 아님
det.tip: In one experiment, ___ sent clowns → 실험 주체 = researchers(연구자)

questions.passage: Although being ill is quite serious, some trips to the hospital now include unexpected laughter. Healthcare workers have been dressing up like clowns to help patients relax and reduce the stress staying in the hospital can cause. Evidence suggests the laughter these medical clowns create is as effective as some medication. In one experiment, researchers sent clowns to entertain children being prepared for surgery. One group of kids spent about half an hour with a clown, while a second group of children received a sedative instead. The kids who met with clowns showed the same reduction in anxiety as those who were given the sedative. It is believed that medical clowns could also be used to help kids with __________ and young burn victims in need of painful bandage-changing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'medical clowns could also be used to help kids with ___(의료 광대가 ___가 있는 아이들을 돕는 데에도 쓰일 수 있다)'예요. 광대가 정서적으로 도울 수 있는 대상으로 언급된 것은 자폐죠.

① fever: 열은 약으로 다루지 광대로 다루지 않음

② hunger: 배고픔은 지문과 무관

③ boredom: 지루함은 지문에 언급 없음

④ autism: '자폐가 있는 아이들'을 돕는 데 쓰일 수 있다 ←정답
det.tip: help kids with ___ + young burn victims → autism(자폐)
